name: teacache4wan22_threshold_scan_vbench16_coverage
purpose: Locate TeaCache thresholds nearest 1.8x, 2.4x, and 3.0x inference speedup.

prompt_selection.method: Eleven deterministic Vbench200 IDs: eight approximately evenly spaced anchors plus the minimal three records required to cover all 16 VBench dimensions.

latency.aggregation: ratio of sums over the same eleven prompts

flops.profile: Calflops 0.3.2 full/always-on plus dense FlashAttention correction

quality.vbench_score: Vbench200 16-dimension subset total_score over the same 11 prompts

execution.assignment: round-robin prompts; every baseline and threshold for a prompt stays on one physical GPU
execution.warmup: one unreported full-compute generation per worker before measured runs
execution.model_lifetime: Each worker constructs one persistent WanT2V pipeline and reuses it for its warm-up and assigned measured runs.
execution.host_memory_constraint: Use two concurrent persistent A14B workers on this 251 GiB no-swap host. Three concurrent model conversions reduced available memory to 54 GiB before generation and were stopped at zero measured samples.
